compilerFlags: Portable CPU baseline, O3, fat LTO, codegen-units=1, no fast-math, no target-cpu=native
caveats: The first one-thread baseline samples in thread-scan-v1 overlapped an unrelated compilation and must not be used as clean evidence. Later balanced ABBA and full runs were isolated.
Full v2 and packet prototype timings are exploratory runs; the final repeated batch measurements are stored separately.
Parallel centroid reductions can cause tiny floating-point differences. Force law, theta and cooling schedule were preserved.
PGO geometric mean speedup was 1.0110, below the existing 1.03 selection threshold. The unprofiled baseline was selected.
In the runner output, firstTickMs measures the first native API call; with batchSize > 1 it covers that many ticks.
Batching reduced peak RSS substantially, but these full-run timings do not demonstrate a CPU-time improvement over individual native calls.
